# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 29,542 across 2 platforms (youtube: 25,832, instagram: 3,710).
- Content date range: 2017-05-08 to 2026-08-02.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.5%, neutral 7.3%, negative 7.2%.
- youtube: positive 63.7%, neutral 21.2%, negative 15.1%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.492, neutral 0.496, positive 0.509 (spread 0.017).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: business, time, build, real - 20,080 posts.
- T5: understand, easy, easy understand, simple - 1,672 posts.
- T3: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,020 posts.
- T1: course, step, completed, engineer - 870 posts.
- T4: start, step, ready start, scratch - 784 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: business, time, build, real (+6.5 pts).
- Rising: T2: clear, wish, understandable, clear understandable (-0.33 pts).
- Rising: T4: start, step, ready start, scratch (-0.37 pts).
- Declining: T1: course, step, completed, engineer (-1.83 pts).
- Declining: T5: understand, easy, easy understand, simple (-2.91 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 4,943 posts.
- AI Agents - 3,600 posts.
- Automation - 3,526 posts.
- Startup - 3,322 posts.
- Digital Marketing - 2,322 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=6, UMass coherence -0.8406 (more coherent than LDA).
